content: Hinge requires 4-6 photos; Bumble recommends 4-6 with a max of 6 and requires the face clearly visible in every photo (no sunglasses/hats/group shots as primary). Tinder now requires Face Check (liveness selfie video vs profile photos) for new users in some regions as of late 2025, awarding a Photo Verified badge. First/primary photo must be a clear, close-up, unobstructed face shot.
